analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Contractors
analysis.quote: We may disclose personal information to contractors or associates to carry out your requests (for example, to complete a pay.gov transaction)

analysis.headline: Interacts with Third-Parties
analysis.quote: We work with third-party applications that are not exclusively operated or controlled by the Library of Congress to provide a better web presentation and user experience.

analysis.headline: Persistent Cookies Track You
analysis.quote: Persistent cookies store information on your computers for longer periods of time and across multiple visits.

analysis.headline: Web Beacons Track Your Emails
analysis.quote: We may also use web beacons in HTML emails that we send subscribers who have opted in to receive email from us, to determine whether our recipients have opened those emails and/or clicked on links in those emails.

analysis.headline: Automatically Collects Your Location
analysis.quote: The internet protocol address, which can reveal cities, states, and countries where web visits originated

analysis.headline: Children's PII May Be Disclosed
analysis.quote: We will disclose information about a child under the age of 13 if it is necessary to protect the child, the website itself, or to respond to a law enforcement inquiry or court order.

analysis.headline: You Must Ensure Privacy Rights
analysis.quote: all users are responsible for complying with all privacy and publicity rights, rules, and applicable laws when accessing and utilizing the collections.

analysis.headline: Your PII May Be In Collections
analysis.quote: it is possible that some online collections items contain personally identifiable information.
